summary: AstroMed-AI is an offline-first, bilingual (English/Arabic) autonomous clinical and mission operating system engineered for long-duration deep-space exploration (ISS, Lunar Gateway, and Mars Transit). Addressing up to 22-minute communication latencies and bandwidth constraints, the platform empowers non-physician Crew Medical Officers with on-device DenseNet-121 radiography diagnostics, ISS eFAST lung ultrasound AI co-pilot, 3D holographic bio-avatar physiological tracking, cosmic-radiation-aware smart pharmacy management, and lightweight (< 2 KB JSON) DSN telemetry downlinks. Built by Ibn Khaldun Team for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
details:
AstroMed-AI is an offline-first, bilingual (English/Arabic) autonomous clinical and mission operating system engineered by Ibn Khaldun Team for long-duration deep-space exploration (ISS, Lunar Gateway, and Mars Transit). - What it does & How it works: Addressing up to 22-minute Earth-communication latencies, the platform empowers non-physician Crew Medical Officers (CMOs) with on-device DenseNet-121 radiography diagnostics (trained on >112,000 X-ray images), an ISS eFAST portable lung ultrasound AI co-pilot, an interactive 3D holographic bio-avatar for real-time SANS and physiological tracking, cosmic-radiation-aware smart pharmacy management, and lightweight (< 2 KB JSON) DSN telemetry downlinks. It also integrates a space mission design simulator (Challenge 13) and a junior astronaut medical trainer. - Benefits & Impact: Eliminates reliance on real-time Earth flight surgeons during acute medical emergencies in deep space, ensuring crew survival, while offering powerful Earth dual-use capabilities for remote telemedicine in rural clinics and disaster zones. - Tools & Technologies: Built using Python 3, Streamlit, PyTorch, TorchXRayVision, OpenCV (for B-line image filtering), Plotly, and Google 3D WebGL Model-Viewer. - Creativity & Team Effort: Combines multiple challenges into a unified, lightweight, offline-capable space medicine operating system with full bilingual (English/Arabic) accessibility.
